name: vol_expansion_dxy_easing_majors
rationale: A vol_realized expansion that lands alongside a weakening dollar is a liquidity-driven vol-regime shift that favors long majors. Thesis: arm long on vol_realized cross_up confirmed by dxy cross_down. Disconfirmer: both legs are crosses (no level-in-disguise); the control is to also test vol_realized cross_up ALONE — if the dollar-easing leg adds no edge it is inert, and if vol alone is flat then the dollar leg is doing the work. The two-cross conjunction tests whether the liquidity-plus-vol regime shift is jointly necessary.
catalyst: realized vol expands while the dollar weakens
